Singapore NParks explicitly lists both self-pollination and fauna-mediated pollination. Encode conservatively as mixed_or_variable rather than autonomous-only. Independent literature also states fruiting by self-pollination, but does not report a controlled bagging design. This directly contradicts the public-Wave52 Pouteria support-two rule autonomous_selfing_capacity=absent, so Pouteria genus promotion is blocked.
